mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A declining unemployment rate over the past month indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE has declined over the prior month, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.5%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1850 thousand units, it signals a robust housing market that drives economic growth and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST > 1850, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising month-over-month CPIAUCSL (above 0.2%) combined with a stable month-over-month FEDFUNDS (change <= 0.1%) signals inadequate monetary policy response to inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
regime_hint: inflationary pressure with inadequate monetary response
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.2% and FEDFUNDS MoM <= 0.1%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in industrial production (above 0.5%) and housing starts (above 0.3%) signals a broad-based economic expansion that boosts corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where INDPRO MoM > 0.5% and HOUST MoM > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 5%), strong payroll growth (PAYEMS MoM > 50k) signals a tight labor market that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE < 5% and PAYEMS MoM > 50k, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening regime (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 consecutive months), high inflation (CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.3%) signals aggressive rate hikes that depress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising for 3 months)
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS has risen for 3 consecutive months and CPIAUCSL MoM > 0.3%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
